overview_description.description: Empathy is a platform for families to deal with the loss of their people. Empathy combines technology and human support to provide a digital companion application built to empower bereaved families. The company's flagship offering is a multi-platform app that guides users through the emotional and practical aspects following the loss of a loved one. This includes assistance with tasks such as funeral planning, closing accounts, and managing estate affairs. Empathy's approach is designed to reduce the complexity and stress associated with these responsibilities.

product.name: Empathy Support Platform
product.description: A digital and human-support system that helps individuals and families manage bereavement, estate-related responsibilities, leave, and other significant life transitions.

product.name: Empathy LifeVault™
product.description: A digital estate-planning and legacy-management solution for creating legally compliant documents and organizing assets, directives, and other information for future use.

product.name: Empathy Loss Support
product.description: A bereavement-support service that guides families through grief and the practical, legal, financial, and administrative tasks following a death.

product.name: Empathy Leave Support
product.description: A support solution for employees and families managing leave associated with bereavement and other significant life transitions.

product.name: Empathy Client Connect
product.description: An institutional support capability that helps organizations provide coordinated guidance and communication to people navigating loss, estate matters, and related life events.

product.name: Empathy Care Team Support
product.description: Human guidance from trained care professionals who help individuals and families understand and complete practical and emotional steps during loss and other difficult transitions.
